changelog: A title's meta line is tidier: the certificate reads as the board writes it (15, not GB-15) in its own outlined badge between the line's dots, Rotten Tomatoes scores carry the tomato or splat and the popcorn bucket instead of boxed labels and thumbs, and the scores sit in the line's own grey. A post-play trailer starts at half volume, scaled to the player's own volume.
description: Apple TV-style theme, home hero and season shelves for the web client.
